name: Veilance
why: Arc'teryx's city line from 2009: GORE-TEX blazers and overcoats in black and slate, every factory named on the page; sold in Arc'teryx stores and online, no door of its own.
origin: Founded in 2009 in Canada (an Arc'teryx line; Arc'teryx founded 1989 by Vancouver-based climbers); city of Veilance's founding not stated on the brand's pages by Arc'teryx (no individual founder named by the brand) and press: Errolson Hugh (ACRONYM) helped develop the line with Arc'teryx from 2007, first release 2009 and Taka Kasuga creative director (Hypebeast, 30 Oct 2019).

craft_evidence.owned: none for Veilance: every one of 67 men's PDPs names a third-party factory (Zplus, Maxport, Youngone, Leverstyle, Huizhou Charming, Viet Thuan, Spectre, Karian), all in China or Vietnam, each linked to an Arc'teryx supply-chain partner page; no Arc'teryx-owned facility appears on any Veilance PDP
craft_evidence.makers: yes, 67 of 67 PDPs: manufacturingFacility names the factory and country (Zplus Company Limited 18; Maxport Nam Dinh 12 + Thai Binh 1; Youngone Nam Dinh 10; Leverstyle 10; Huizhou Charming 8; Viet Thuan (RSI) 6; Spectre 1; Karian Taicang 1); partner pages give parent company, years of partnership and headcount (Huizhou Charming: since 2005, 1,575 employees)
craft_evidence.mills: no: fabric and dye origin countries are stated (Japan, Taiwan, China, Thailand, Vietnam) and fabrics carry trade names (GORE-TEX, Pertex, Fortius, Burly), but no cloth or yarn mill is named
craft_evidence.madein: 93% (62 of 67 PDPs carry 'Origin of Manufacture'; the other 5 name the facility and its country only); fabric and dye origin stated on 67 of 67
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed for the parent only: Arc'teryx 'Founded by a crew of Vancouver, Canada-based climbers in 1989' (who-we-are page); Veilance's own pages give no founding date (2009 launch is from press, Hypebeast 2019)
craft_evidence.process: partly: PDP construction notes are specific (ultrasonic welded seams, taped and felled seams, bonded wool softshell, 3D-knitted Betaspun yarn, gsm weights per fabric), and partner pages describe the factories; no Veilance-specific making page
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every Veilance PDP names the factory that made it and links a partner page with its parent company, start of partnership and headcount, and states fabric, dye and manufacture countries, which is unusually checkable. But nothing is made in a facility Arc'teryx owns, no mill is named, and Veilance's own pages carry no dated founding story; a 3 (named makers, owns nothing), not a 4.

ownership.owner: Amer Sports, Inc. (NYSE: AS), through Arc'teryx; Veilance is an Arc'teryx collection sold on arcteryx.com (site footer: "Arc'teryx - an Amer Sports Brand")
